'''Ariane Mézard''' is a French mathematician and a professor of mathematics at [[Sorbonne University]] who works in [[arithmetic geometry]].

==Education==
Mézard studied at the [[École normale supérieure de Lyon]] from 1992 to 1996.<ref name="CV">{{cite web |url=https://webusers.imj-prg.fr/~ariane.mezard/CV.html |website=Ariane Mézard |title=Education and Employment History |accessdate=7 March 2021}}</ref><ref name="UVSQ">{{cite web |url=http://archive.uvsq.fr/une-mathematicienne-reconnue-a-l-institut-universitaire-de-france-420606.kjsp |website=[[Versailles Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines University]] |title=Une mathématicienne reconnue à l'Institut universitaire de France |language=fr |date=19 November 2010 |accessdate=11 March 2021}}</ref> She received her Ph.D. under the supervision of Roland Gillard at [[Joseph Fourier University]] in 1998.<ref name="MG">{{MathGenealogy|id=56124}}</ref><ref name="UVSQ"/> She received her [[habilitation]] in 2005 during her time at [[Paris-Sud University]].<ref name="CV"/>

==Career==
Mézard worked as a postdoc at the [[Mathematical Sciences Research Institute]] and [[Regensburg University]] in 1999 and 2000 respectively.<ref name="CV"/><ref name="UVSQ"/> She was an assistant professor at Paris-Sud University from 2000 to 2006 and also served in the same role at [[École normale supérieure (Paris)|École normale supérieure]] from 2005 to 2006.<ref name="CV"/><ref name="UVSQ"/> From 2006 to 2012, she was a professor at [[Versailles Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines University]].<ref name="CV"/><ref name="UVSQ"/> Since 2012, Mézard has been a professor of mathematics at [[Sorbonne University]].<ref name="CV"/> Since 2016, she has worked as a part-time professor at the École normale supérieure.<ref name="CV"/>

==Recognition==
From 2010 to 2015, Mézard was a junior member of the [[Institut Universitaire de France]] (IUF).<ref name="CV"/><ref name="UVSQ"/> At the time of her appointment to the IUF, she was one of only two women out of its fifty mathematician members.<ref name="UVSQ"/> In 2018, she received the Fulbright for the Future Prize from the [[Fulbright Association]].<ref name="CV"/><ref>{{cite web |url=https://fulbright-france.org/en/fulbright70/fulbright-days-paris |title=Fulbright Days in {{Not a typo|PAris}} |website=[[Fulbright Association|Fulbright France]] |accessdate=7 March 2021}}</ref>
